### Parental Doubt
Author: Dr. James Dobson
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-devotions-for-parents-by-dr-james-dobson/dr-dobson-s-parenting-devotional-july-30.html
Passage: Proverbs 12:25
Points:
- Modern parents are often weighed down by severe self-doubt and feelings of inadequacy.
- This internal worry and anxiety robs mothers and fathers of the joy of parenting.
- Earlier generations did not dwell on self-criticism or constant second-guessing.
- No human parent can achieve perfection, making reliance on God essential.
- Parents should reject cultural pressures and cast their burdens upon the Lord.
